items.name: bay area pin board
items.description: the bay area, from santa rosa down to san jose, drawn in deep blues on cream and set in a light wood frame. hang it, then pin your collection right onto the map: a hike above sausalito, a long lunch in oakland, a drive down to half moon bay. each pin marks an adventure right where it happened. together they hold the memories, out on the wall for friends and family to see and ask about.
